# Merdeka LLM

> Malaysia's sovereign AI Large Language Model and AI Sovereignty as a Service platform, built by Malaysians, hosted in Malaysian data centers, trained on local data. Powered by Agmo Group.

Merdeka LLM by Agmo Group offers AI Sovereignty as a Service, LLM Training as a Service (with Phison's aiDAPTIV+ and SNS), and the LLM Gig Economy — a curatorship/contributor platform for Malaysians to help train Malaysia's own AI.

## Pages

- [Merdeka LLM](https://merdekallm.com/): Malaysia's AI for a Sovereign and Empowered Future
- [Why Sovereignty Matters](https://merdekallm.com/why-sovereignty-matters/): AI Sovereignty as a Service — localized, Malaysia-hosted AI solutions
- [Merdeka Model Hub](https://merdekallm.com/merdeka-model-llm/): Real-world applications of Merdeka LLM across Legal, HR, Education, and Finance
- [LLM Training as a Service](https://merdekallm.com/llm-training-as-a-service/): Scalable LLM training, in partnership with Phison's aiDAPTIV+ and SNS
- [LLM Gig Economy](https://merdekallm.com/llm-gig-economy/): Contribution and curatorship platform for Malaysians
- [Become a Curator](https://merdekallm.com/curator/): Review, refine, and validate data used to train Merdeka LLM
- [Become a Contributor](https://merdekallm.com/contributor/): Supply and refine the data that powers Merdeka LLM
